title: leptogramma pilosiuscula
intro: Leptogramma pilosiuscula, commonly known as the hairy-leaved leptogramma, is a type of plant species that belongs to the family of Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Leptogramma pilosiuscula include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
